title: centrosema hastatum
intro: Centrosema hastatum, commonly known as the sensitive plant or touch-me-not, is a perennial legume native to tropical and subtropical regions of the Americas. The plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Centrosema hastatum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which make it useful in treating various ailments. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
